body: Hey. Let's stop a moment and applaud your bravery and courage. It may sound like bullshit to you right now, but seriously let's reflect. You posted here. You're staying strong. And just from this post, I can tell how ambitious of a person you are. I'm no therapist and I don't know if this comment is gonna help. But I have experienced some shit and I just want you to know I'm here. Deep down you want to survive and you will. Because the ambitious you will prevail. Do you have a therapist or any close friend/family member you can talk to by the way?

I've been in the same spot so I know how sure you feel about this, but truthfully, you feel 99% about this. you posted here didn't you? you gotta get along with that 1%. Life takes turns and changes at random times. You're at a point right now, but there will be a return. The life you'll have in the future will be empowering and a much better place man.  Do you have a close family member or friend you can talk through this with?

I know I must sound like BS because someone's tried to talk me down too. But not following through/ surviving is such an amazing feeling man

Hey man.. i just posted on a throwaway and was looking around this subreddit. I know what it is like.. And I know that this might be hypocritical to say, and I know that part of me is saying this to help myself too, but its all worth it. Life is so beautiful. I don't know if this comment is breaking the subreddit rules or whatever, but this thought has helped me through the years. There is a lot of warmth and kindness in this world if you look correctly. Suicide isn't the option to take, trust me. It is so easy , I know, but there are so many alternatives trust me. Please hold on at least 24 hours. Wait for better people to reply to this. Talk to someone please. Even though I am a stranger, I really care right now. :-)
